 How Christian Bale Transformed Into Al Davis for ‘Madden’
 Sports Illustrated Fri, November 20, 2026 at 9:43 PM UTC Christian Bale sits down with Sports Illustrated to break down his transformation into iconic Raiders owner Al Davis for his newest movie, Madden.
